title: Base draft L187: peer auth no longer out of scope
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 ~L187 says authentication is outside the protocol (overlay network, mTLS, bearer tokens). For peer (server-to-server) requests federation-00 now defines authentication; scope the L187 statement to client authentication and point to {{JMAP-CHAT-FED}}. Follow-up to jmap-chat-spec-sh60 (peer auth via RFC 9421 signatures, approved 2026-10-19).
